notes: Captured from the WRI GitHub repository (output_database/global_power_plant_database.csv, v1.3.0, 12.0 MB, 34,936 plants) and trimmed without altering any kept line (CRLF line endings preserved): the header, all 195 nuclear plants, an even sample of 992 plants of 50 MW or more across the other 14 fuels (in file order, so spread over 100+ countries), and 56 plants below 50 MW that the adapter must skip. The requested ~1,200 non-nuclear rows did not fit the 450 KB budget because rows average about 350 bytes. Static reference data (2021) without per-record timestamps. The malformed variant was authored by hand.
